outcome: Fetal outcomes (NICU admission, prematurity, jaundice, birth weight)
cohort: The study included all pregnant women who tested positive for COVID-19 infection from April 2020 to September 2021 in a tertiary maternal hospital in Ras Al Khaimah, UAE.
finding: Adverse maternal outcomes, obesity, and mode of delivery were related to COVID-19 severity in pregnant patients, while adverse fetal outcomes were generally unaffected, except for jaundice and birth weight.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean delivery was significantly associated with hospitalized COVID-19 patients, and mode of delivery was related to COVID-19 severity.
